verdict.rationale: Built-in evals are a fair axis for an agent-building SDK, so the story applies, but the evidence pack never documents a built-in eval framework, scoring, or CI eval runner. Hooks, structured outputs, and observability mentions in the hosting docs are adjacent building blocks, not built-in evals, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI
